text:
Tyrell Harper: Hey team — Tyrell here, joining Platform/Infra today! Quick asks: MDM + laptop image, VPN access, and SSH to build hosts. Also who is my onboarding buddy? Fun fact: I bake sourdough and bring loaves sometimes.

Eva Li: welcome Tyrell!! :tada: People Ops sent the MDM invite earlier today. Check your inbox + JAMF. If missing, @me and I'll re-trigger. Buddy assignment will be posted in a sec.

Jordan Park: hi Tyrell 30 adding you to #infra and #platform-ops. For SSH keys pls paste your public key in DM or here. Example:

```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "tyrell@redwood.ai" -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood.pub
```

VPN is WireGuard, onboarding script at https://intra.redwood/infra/vpn-onboard. Run `./wg-onboard.sh` and ping me if the script errors.

Sam Wells: hardware update: we shipped the company Mac image to the address on file this morning, ETA 2 days. I'll DM tracking. You should also see calendar invites for "Infra Standup" and "Onboarding 1:1".

Maya Torres: hey Tyrell 3 I'm your onboarding buddy, welcome! Happy to walk you through the first-week checklist and intro repos. Standup is casual, don't stress. I have a boardgame night intro question for you already :grin:.

InfraBot: New-hire: Tyrell Harper added to onboarding tracker. Tasks created: MDM invite, VPN account, SSH key provisioning, access to build-hosts, add to infra-repos.

Noah Simms: if you want a terraform starter template, I can fork infra-starter and add you as reviewer. Also if you like boardgames, we have a small group on Fridays.

Tyrell Harper: Thanks all! I posted pubkey to Jordan DM. Quick question on secrets: what's the recommended practice for storing service account creds? We use KMS/HSM, right?

Sarah Chen: @Tyrell correct 3 primary storage is KMS-backed vault. I'll add you to the key-access doc and enable read-only for your service account to start. For HSM requests we need a manager approval ticket.

Tyrell Harper: Perfect. One more tiny ask: can someone confirm VPN client version for macOS? My home machine is macOS Ventura.

Jordan Park: wg client v1.0.202 is the supported build on Ventura. If you hit an error, send the logs from `/var/log/wg-onboard.log`.

Eva Li: welcome again!! We'll schedule a coffee chat with Platform next week. And if you really bake, pls bring a loaf :bread: 

Tyrell Harper: Will do. Excited to be here, thanks everyone.
